tasks.short: Compile, administer and grade agricultural science examinations

steps.what: Compile the actual agricultural science examination, selecting suitable existing questions and authoring needed new questions and marking criteria
inputs: Teacher-maintained question bank and actual course material
outputs: Teacher-authored exam and marking criteria

steps.what: Check the complete final exam, answer key, marking criteria, student scope and administration settings
inputs: Complete exam and criteria from s1
outputs: Exact checked exam version and administration settings

steps.what: Release the exact checked examination to the named students
inputs: Exact final exam and settings checked in s2
outputs: Released exam

steps.what: Administer the actual examination and handle student questions and exceptions
outputs: Actual student-produced responses and administration exceptions

steps.what: Score only closed-response items against the teacher's exact checked key
inputs: Exact answer key checked in s2
outputs: Staged closed-item scores and unmatched responses

steps.what: Grade open agricultural reasoning and interpretation answers and resolve scoring exceptions using the actual criteria
outputs: Teacher-awarded open scores and resolved exceptions

steps.what: Check the full grade set against responses, keys, criteria and student identities
inputs: Actual closed and teacher-awarded open scores
outputs: Checked complete grade set for exact assessment and students

steps.what: Stage exact checked grades from the LMS into the separate student-registry draft fields
inputs: Checked structured grade set from s7
Explicit student, course, assessment and grade mapping
Existing student information registry, defined as OTHER
outputs: Draft registry entries with exact identity and grade reconciliation

steps.what: Check every final registry entry against the checked grade set, assessment and student identity
outputs: Exact checked final registry grade entries

steps.what: Commit the exact checked final grades to the student registry
inputs: Exact complete grade entries checked in s9
outputs: Recorded assessment grades

tasks.design: Configure native {LMS} question reuse and exact-key scoring, with a staged import of checked grades into {OTHER}. The teacher authors and checks the exam, administers it, grades open reasoning and checks the complete final registry entries before committing them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual question assembly, closed-item scoring and grade re-entry can repeat existing information.
tasks.enabler_now: Native question banks, exact keys and registry import fields can handle those explicit operations.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing agricultural reasoning and fair handling of exceptions require academic judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Choose valid questions and evaluate what the student actually understands.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: LMS question banks and exact-key scoring and structured grade imports can reduce assembly, closed-item arithmetic and re-entry while teachers retain academic judgement.

assumptions: Representative mixed closed/open examination with actual separate-registry grade re-entry; not a measured baseline or universal exam format.

Teacher authors questions, criteria and exact keys in s1; native reuse reduces assembly only. Students produce responses in s4 and actual grading, checking and source-grade capture are counted in s5-s7; no free clean grade feed.

Native features first. Existing bank reuse, scoring and registry interfaces are baseline and earn no new saving. Missing identities or incompatible assessment codes remain manual, with no inferred grades or model assessment.
s8 is an explicit draft import distinct from both source-grade review and final registry checking. Any exam or registry edit invalidates its relevant final-version check.
Release and near-zero registry commit earn no saving. Deduplicate same registry and grade work with 5787.
All 100 illustrative focal points: gross 6 plus 5 plus 10 equals 21, less upkeep 4 gives net 17.
unknowns: Current exam mix and actual registry re-entry
research_questions: Which existing LMS and registry features already remove these manual steps?

already_counted.description: Retained question authoring and final exam review, complete grade review and final registry verification

incremental.description: Maintain question-bank settings, exact-key rules and registry mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete exam, key, criteria and settings checked in s2; changes require recheck
Exact complete registry grade entries checked in s9; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional manual exam assembly, closed scoring and registry-transfer scenario: gross 21 less upkeep 4; all academic decisions retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain student attendance, grades and required records

steps.what: Observe and capture actual student attendance and required participation facts for the class
outputs: Teacher-captured attendance and participation with absences or uncertainty explicit

steps.what: Collect and verify actual awarded grades and other required record fields, resolving missing or disputed entries
outputs: Checked structured source record set with student, course, assessment and status fields

steps.what: Import exact checked attendance and grade fields into the separate student-registry draft records
inputs: Existing student information registry, defined as OTHER
outputs: Staged registry records with unmatched identifiers held

steps.what: Calculate explicitly defined attendance totals and grade aggregates from the checked record set
outputs: Traceable totals and aggregate fields with missing components marked

steps.what: Check the complete final student-record update against actual attendance, awarded grades and required fields
outputs: Exact checked complete record update

steps.what: Commit the exact checked student-record update
inputs: Exact complete update checked in s5
outputs: Updated attendance, grades and required student records

tasks.design: Use native {OTHER} draft-record imports from checked {LMS} fields and explicit aggregation rules. The teacher captures real attendance, verifies actual grades and checks the complete final update before committing it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual re-entry and aggregation can duplicate actual class and assessment records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native import fields and explicit totals can preserve exact student and assessment mappings.
tasks.still_hard: Attendance uncertainty and disputed grades require human resolution.
tasks.human_edge: Know what actually happened and keep incomplete or contested entries explicit.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: structured student-record imports and explicit aggregate rules can reduce re-entry while actual attendance capture and grade verification remain human.

assumptions: Conditional record-maintenance episode with actual manual re-entry and totals, not a measured baseline. Actual attendance is captured in s1; actual source grades are produced in assessment work and teacher collection/checking is counted in s2.
No inferred attendance, engagement or grades. Missing fields remain manual; disputed grades are held for actual academic resolution.
Native imports and rules first; current equivalent interfaces and calculations are baseline and earn zero new saving. No free cleaned student feed.
Commit is negligible and fully retained. No student message, grade-change authorization or certification send is hidden; actual required separate actions must be included if in scope.
Identical grade import/verification/commit actions shared with 5784 are counted once. All 100 illustrative focal points: gross 20 plus 10 equals 30, less upkeep 3 gives net 27.
unknowns: Current source-to-registry interfaces and actual record requirements
research_questions: Which grade, attendance and aggregate fields still require manual re-entry or arithmetic?

already_counted.description: Actual attendance capture, source-grade verification and complete final record checking

incremental.description: Maintain registry field mappings and explicit aggregate rules

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete attendance/grade update checked in s5; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional manual registry-transfer and aggregate scenario: gross 30 less upkeep 3; all actual source capture and checks retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in student recruitment, registration and placement

steps.what: Participate in actual agricultural-course recruitment discussions and answer prospective students' questions
outputs: Recruitment discussions and actual student questions

steps.what: Collect and verify actual student registration information and course prerequisites within the teacher's assigned role
inputs: Existing registration case system, defined as OTHER
outputs: Checked structured case fields and unresolved evidence gaps

steps.what: Stage exact verified student and course fields from the application record into the separate registration draft
inputs: Structured case fields checked in s2
outputs: Staged registration entry with unmatched identifiers held

steps.what: Evaluate actual placement needs and exceptions with students and the responsible programme staff
outputs: Human placement recommendation and unresolved owner decisions

steps.what: Complete and check the exact registration case entry and actual placement recommendation
inputs: Staged entry and actual human recommendation
outputs: Complete checked registration support entry with actual status

steps.what: Save the exact checked registration support entry
inputs: Exact complete entry checked in s5
outputs: Saved case entry with placement pending or resolved as actually authorized

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} exact-field imports between the existing application and registration records where the teacher currently re-enters them. Recruitment discussion and placement judgement remain human, and the complete case entry is checked before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual application-to-registration transfer can duplicate verified student information.
tasks.enabler_now: Native draft imports can preserve exact student and course identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Student circumstances and placement exceptions require academic judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the student and resolve ambiguous readiness evidence.

ambition.what: Support existing recruitment and registration participation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact-field registration imports can reduce manual re-entry while recruitment and placement judgements remain human.

assumptions: Representative assigned-teacher episode with actual registration re-entry; not a measured baseline or assumption that all teachers handle the registrar's work.

Students produce application information; teacher evidence verification and structured capture are counted in s2. Missing identifiers or ambiguous prerequisites remain manual, with no inferred eligibility or student ranking.
Native configuration first. Existing application/registry integration earns no new saving. Registration-owner labour is not eliminated or transferred for free.

Save is negligible and fully retained. This records the teacher's actual support/recommendation within assigned authority; any formal admission or placement authorization must inspect the complete final case before a separate decision/commit with its labour added.
No recruitment follow-up or student outcome message is silently sent. All 100 illustrative focal points: gross import saving 25 less upkeep 3 gives net 22.
unknowns: Actual teacher registration remit and current native integration
research_questions: Does the assigned teacher actually re-enter verified application fields today?

already_counted.description: Student evidence verification, human placement evaluation and complete final case check

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete registration support entry checked in s5; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional teacher-owned manual registration-transfer saving 25 less upkeep 3; recruitment and placement judgement retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and obtain textbooks and laboratory supplies

steps.what: Find and check current textbook and laboratory-equipment catalogue information for the actual course need
inputs: Supplier-produced catalogue, price and availability information
outputs: Checked candidate material and supply information

steps.what: Select suitable textbooks, materials or laboratory equipment considering learning purpose, suitability and available budget
outputs: Teacher-selected items, quantities and rationale

steps.what: Prepare the actual purchase request with selected item identifiers, quantities and delivery details
inputs: Actual selected items and quantities from s2
outputs: Complete draft purchase request

steps.what: Check the complete final purchase request, quantities, cost and actual delivery instructions
inputs: Original course need and catalogue evidence
outputs: Exact checked purchase request

steps.what: Submit the exact checked purchase request to the internal purchasing team
inputs: Exact final request checked in s4
outputs: Submitted internal purchase request

steps.what: Inspect the actual received textbooks, materials or laboratory equipment against the requested items
inputs: Checked request and actual purchasing outcome
outputs: Actual receipt observations and discrepancies

steps.what: Capture and check the complete actual receipt entry and any unresolved discrepancies
outputs: Exact checked receipt entry

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual receipt entry
inputs: Exact final receipt entry checked in s7
outputs: Saved actual receipt status

tasks.design: Use native {PARTNER_PORTAL} catalogue filters and {PROCUREMENT} forms for confirmed item fields. The teacher selects materials, checks the final request before submitting it and records actual receipt only after inspecting delivered goods.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated catalogue navigation and fixed-field request entry can duplicate known information.
tasks.enabler_now: Native filters and request fields can reduce those specific preparation tasks.
tasks.still_hard: Educational suitability and actual delivered condition require teacher judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Choose material that serves the course and identify unsuitable or incomplete deliveries.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native catalogue filters and purchasing forms can reduce lookup and fixed-field entry while educational selection and physical receipt inspection remain human.

assumptions: Representative teacher-owned purchase-request and receipt episode, not a measured baseline. Suppliers produce catalogue records; teacher source verification, item choice, quantities and actual receipt capture are counted in s1-s3 and s6-s7.
Native features first; existing filters and forms earn no new saving. s3 reduces fixed fields only; no automatic textbook selection or laboratory-equipment substitution.

Purchasing staff retain actual supplier ordering, authority checks and delivery coordination in their existing work; no saving in their labour is claimed. Any new transferred checking or capture must be added before estimating team savings.
Teacher submission is an internal request, not an authorized supplier order. Supplier commitment and payment are not silently executed.
Receipt status follows actual delivery and inspection, with discrepancies explicit. Submission and near-zero same-system save earn no saving.
All 100 illustrative focal effort points: gross 6 plus 3.8 equals 9.8, less upkeep 2 gives net 7.8.
unknowns: Actual purchasing remit, native forms and receipt workflow
research_questions: Which catalogue navigation and fixed-field entry remain manual for teaching supplies?

already_counted.description: Retained catalogue checking, complete final request check and actual receipt capture/checking

incremental.description: Maintain catalogue links and fixed purchase-request fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete internal purchase request checked in s4; changes require recheck
Exact actual receipt entry checked in s7 after inspection; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional lookup and fixed-field saving 9.8 less upkeep 2; selection, physical receipt and purchasing-owner work retained.
